KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Anga.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

5. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

7. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

8. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

9. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. kitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mitoto

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
